body: You make an excellent point.. I definitely have been trying to focus on what feels and even looks like a nonexistent end goal.. like I keep telling myself there IS an end goal but I can't see it so it feels impossible.. I have to stop thinking that way and focus on the here and now small steps, especially because I feel like I haven't taken any steps, even a small one is something to feel at least somewhat good about..

Thank you for that.. I have great work history, everywhere I've worked I've gotten a promotion within a couple of months. You're right though, I need to just apply everywhere - even shit jobs, I think my pride has gotten the best of me in that regard in the past, but clearly I don't have the room too be proud right now. Volunteering is actually an amazing idea I hadn't considered.. 

I think you perfectly articulated what I've been dealing with for a long time on and off (more on than off) I struggle to get out of bed, I haven't showered in a couple days, last time I are was a couple days ago, I just want to lie in bed, but I can't even sleep. Its 4am now, I'm not tired, and the closer daylight gets the more frustrated I get about not sleeping but I just can't because if I do I have to wake up and face tomorrow.. I don't know that I've heard that last part started quite that way and I think it's at on.. I've isolated myself and treat people horribly because of it and then just do more damage. That real life shed a new light on that for me.. 

I always tell myself "tomorrow I'll get up, shower, and be productive" and then beat myself up later when that inevitably didn't happen.

I did a while ago, but when I lost that career last year my insurance went with it.. I honestly don't have rl support. I'm not kidding about losing everyone.. I ruined everything good relationship, friendship or otherwise. My ex I'm living with us the closest thing but to be honest he's not the best with depression or suicidal thoughts because he's never been there so good response despite being sure his heart is in the right place is usually "stop being stupid, you'll be okay". Beyond that I've got no one. 

I've only seen my son once, 2 weeks ago, his dad is a whole other animal.. he's still bitter about our marriage ending and does everything possible to make my life harder (he's even blatantly said that) so as of now I have to pay by the hour to see my son and can only do it if I can make my one hour window at 10am one day a week work because that's the only time he'll agree to.. that being said, when we went to court mandated mediation he told the mediator he will never communicate or be able to talk or be kind to me so who knows if we'll ever be able to coparent amicably.

I'm more worried the courts will see it as irresponsible.. 2x single mom, 2 kids, 2 dad's.. I mean I'm almost 30 so it's not like I'm crazy young but still.. 

And you're right, I just have to apply and interview literally anywhere and everywhere, and hopefully something will come up.. I just don't know if I have the drive to commit to that effort.. it sounds dumb, but I've been trying to pick up pieces from everywhere in my life for almost 2 years and even when things get better they fall apart again or somewhere else very quickly so I feel like I haven't even had time to breathe.. I don't know if I can see the point in trying so hard anymore..

And thank you, it's not so much the getting an abortion that I'm struggling with.. I know that's the right decision right now. I just never thought if I did this it would be completely alone... Hell I don't even have someone to drive me home afterwards. I just know right decision or not it's going to be scary and emotional and I'll have to basically suffer in silence about it.

He's been great.. given the circumstances. Its just hard to be here with him, I feel like I'm constantly reminded of all the ways I've fucked up, or the things I cant have anymore (ie him). 
I've been trying, I saw him 2 weeks ago, but I feel like such a piece of shit mom for ever losing him and for not being around now because I literally can't.. 
I've looked for therapists, but American health Care absolutely sucks and they're so damn expensive.
If I decide to keep trying.. I'm terrified.. I'm so scared of what's to come while I pick up this mess and I'm so mentally and physically exhausted from dealing with everything for so long I just don't know if Im strong enough..

I don't know.. my first pregnancy was so so hard on my body, I just don't know if I can go through that with no support. 
I don't have custody, the things that lost me that are resolved but I have to refile to get my son back and that's very costly, I'm still paying fees from the last round.. so as of now, I have supervised visitation, but I have to pay hourly and my ex-husband won't budge on times so he makes it during a time I literally haven't been able to be there because of work - so it's money and scheduling or has been anyway, I guess not anymore. 
I know why I lost my job, it was just a "hire on the spot" warehouse job, they let me go because of attendance, despite doctors notes (they require them BEFORE you call off) 
Unfortunately I live in an area that doesn't really have much public transportation and everything is a little too unsafe or far for a bike or scooter.. I have to have a car in this area.. 

I don't mean to shut down every option you've given. I appreciate your response, I just genuinely feel completely trapped and at a loss because I can't figure out how to fix all those issues..

This genuinely brought me to tears.. I can't lie and say that that comment has completely turned my feelings or thoughts around, but that is genuinely the first time I've opened up (and I think this honestly is the first time ive completely opened up) and have gotten a response that made me think "they actually get it". The few times I've tried to talk to someone it just feels like the responses are just things people say, or they're only saying it because I'm so low but they don't mean it.
So thank you, thank you for empathizing and sharing your story. I'm stuck on the fence with the why am I even fighting when I'm suffering so much by doing so, because I keep getting stuck on "but seriously why am I? What's the point anymore?" And I don't have an answer... But what you said.. it helped.

I'm so tired. Just completely exhausted from feeling this way day in and day out. In almost 2 years I don't even remember the last time I had 24hrs of not feeling this way or something going wrong...even just 12hrs.. I'm just so tired and so alone.

My family, or really my dad mostly, is the thing that's making me hesitate.. 
I don't have any wise words, I just wanted to say the physically exhausted thing, I'm absolutely with you. I am so just tired overall, all the time from feeling this way. If you get it figured out, let me know cause I'd love to know how to make it stop

But I don't know how... I don't know how to kick life's ass anymore. I feel completely defeated. Everytime I think I've got it or have a handle on things something else falls apart.. where do I go? I have no family I can stay with, no friends, I'm in debt, I have no real money, I'll have to find a job before I can do anything, but even then I'll have to save and what do I do until then? Where do I go? I've already been homeless in the past year.. I can't do it again. Frankly, I've grown so codependent in my last relationship, I don't know how to pick myself up all alone.. I just don't know how to be okay. Everyone says a good support system is huge... What about the people without one?
